name: Qiu zhi Huiyi Another World
source:
This game is a fan work of the most famous AVG game Memories Off series in China. It follows the line of Memories Off sorekara again and tells a story of healing:

After the wind and rain, Isshu and Inori finally lived happily together. However, the infatuation of countless people turned into deep resentment, and an incredible tomorrow quietly unfolded in front of them... Will Miyabi and Karin live their lives with their missing hearts? What will happen to the future of Yukari and Haya? Who will Sayorin's life be entrusted to? What kind of uproar will Kanata's appearance cause? When a miracle happens, will the angel in the dream return to the world?

(Source: Readme file in patch)
